name: Qwertymonoalphabeticbilateralcipher

description_json.name: QwertyMonoalphabeticBilateralCipher
description_json.idea: A simple, deterministic monoalphabetic substitution cipher that maps the standard alphabetical order (A-Z) directly to the QWERTY keyboard layout sequence. This provides a highly intuitive, single-step bijection that is easy for language models to compute accurately, reducing reasoning errors while maintaining a distinct obfuscation layer. Case is preserved, and all non-alphabetic characters (including digits, spaces, and punctuation) remain completely unchanged.
description_json.encrypt_rules:
Each letter of the plaintext is replaced by its corresponding letter in the QWERTY mapping. The mapping is defined by aligning the standard alphabet 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' with the QWERTY sequence 'qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbnm'. Specifically:
a->q, b->w, c->e, d->r, e->t, f->y, g->u, h->i, i->o, j->p, k->a, l->s, m->d, n->f, o->g, p->h, q->j, r->k, s->l, t->z, u->x, v->c, w->v, x->b, y->n, z->m. Case is preserved (e.g., A->Q, B->W). All non-alphabetic characters (digits, spaces, punctuation) remain completely unchanged.
description_json.decrypt_rules:
Each letter of the ciphertext is replaced by its inverse mapping from the QWERTY sequence back to the standard alphabet. Specifically:
q->a, w->b, e->c, r->d, t->e, y->f, u->g, i->h, o->i, p->j, a->k, s->l, d->m, f->n, g->o, h->p, j->q, k->r, l->s, z->t, x->u, c->v, v->w, b->x, n->y, m->z. Case is preserved (e.g., Q->A, W->B). All non-alphabetic characters (digits, spaces, punctuation) remain completely unchanged.
